faq.question: What does Nuhu mean?
faq.answer: Nuhu is associated with the Arabic form نُوح, whose core sense is nuhu; noah (prophet) (african form).

faq.question: What is the origin of Nuhu?
faq.answer: Nuhu is associated with Arabic. Nuhu is the West African form of Arabic نُوح (Nūḥ), the Quranic form of the prophet Noah.

faq.question: Is Nuhu an Arabic name?
faq.answer: Yes — the underlying form نُوح is Arabic.

faq.question: Is Nuhu an Islamic name?
faq.answer: Nuhu can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.

faq.question: Is Nuhu a Quranic name?
faq.answer: Nuhu should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Nūḥ is the Quranic Arabic form of the prophet Noah and occurs in the Quran.

faq.question: What does Nuhu mean in Urdu?
faq.answer: In Urdu, Nuhu is rendered نوح and carries the sense نوح، نبی کا نام.

faq.question: What does Nuhu mean in Persian?
faq.answer: In Persian, Nuhu is rendered نوح and carries the sense نوح، نام پیامبر.

faq.question: How is Nuhu pronounced?
faq.answer: A romanized syllable approximation is nu-hu. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.question: What are the variants of Nuhu?
faq.answer: Romanization variants include Nuhu, nuhu. Script forms are نوح, نُوح, नूह.

faq.question: Is Nuhu a boy's or girl's name?
faq.answer: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
